name: Astracolypse
description:
About This Game

In a dying desert world, humanity survives in silence — hidden deep beneath the surface. Those born with the gift are not saved... They are exiled...

You are one of them

When the hunger awakens, you are cast out into a world that remembers what humans once were — and fears what they can become.

Everything hunts you. Not because you are weak… but because you are dangerous.

Feed The Hunger

Your power comes at a cost. To survive, you must consume the flesh of the creatures you hunt.

  • Manage a constant hunger that affects combat and survival

  • Hunt creatures for food, materials, and power

  • Recruit and manage a party of outcasts

  • Each character has their own progression, gear, and needs

  • Tactical party-based combat inspired by classic JRPGs
short_desc: Astracolypse is a survival-driven, turn-based RPG set on a hostile alien desert world where exiled humans must hunt, feed, and fight to survive. Build a party of outcasts, manage an ever-growing hunger, and uncover the truth behind a world that hunts you on sight.
